steps.input:
{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-14d1adf6.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Copy the nonzero motif into the zero rectangle, mirrored left-to-right."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    motif = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] != grid[0][0]]
    if not zeros or not motif:
        return out
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    mr0, mr1 = min(r for r, c in motif), max(r for r, c in motif)
    mc0, mc1 = min(c for r, c in motif), max(c for r, c in motif)
    if zr1 - zr0 != mr1 - mr0 or zc1 - zc0 != mc1 - mc0:
        return out
    for dr in range(zr1 - zr0 + 1):
        for dc in range(zc1 - zc0 + 1):
            out[zr0 + dr][zc0 + dc] = grid[mr0 + dr][mc1 - dc]
    return out
"
}
